name: bea-agents
description: BEA — Binary Execution Analysis: dynamic binary analysis for agents

scripts.build: node scripts/lib/lock.mjs build -- "node scripts/clean.mjs && npm run build:ts && npm run build:agent && npm run build:native && npm run build:bridge && npm run build:skill"
scripts.check: node scripts/generate.mjs --check && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:shared && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run knip && node scripts/verify-test-discovery.mjs
scripts.test: vitest run --project unit --project mcp-boundary --project cli-boundary --project http-boundary
scripts.test:process: npm run build && vitest run --project process-boundary
scripts.test:emu: npm run build && vitest run --project emu-boundary
scripts.test:acceptance: npm run build && npm run build:fixtures && vitest run --project acceptance
scripts.verify:frida:windows: npm run build && npm run build:fixtures && node scripts/verify-frida-windows.mjs
scripts.verify:emulation: npm run build && npm run build:fixtures && node scripts/verify-emulation.mjs
